title: Enhancement: Support OSFP in PDDF
author: michaelc-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the enhancement

Update PDDF platform creation to include OSFP optical devices

### Current Behavior

pddfparse and pddfapi do not currently support OSFP


### Proposed Behavior

Be able to specify OSFP devices in a pddf JSON file and have the proper drivers instantiated for platform support
